question: How are the middle and top sections of the linga shaped and designated in this arrangement?
premises: The middle section has a specific form.
The top is round and designated as the Shiva part.
inference: In the middle is the eight-cornered section, and at the top is the round Shiva part.
uncertainties: The meaning of vomaṃ is unclear in this context.
plain_english: In the middle is the voma and the eight-cornered section, and at the top is the round Shiva part.
